reasons.text: Buys feedstock inside a closed loop of 3 recyclers trading the same material (17% of its feedstock)
Energy charges do not match units x tariff on 100% of bills (worst bill charged 87% of expected)
Certificates claim more than the declared monthly capacity in 27% of months
100% of certificate tonnes were sold below the cost of recycling (average 0.66x the cost floor)
63% of certificate tonnes were generated more than 45 days after the processing month
32% of all certificates were generated in a single month

model_signals.label: membership of a closed trading loop

ring_partners: registry/entities:ENT-Z6B1E6N (1,573 t sold to this plant)

PIBO-LYS3GQ1 Hind Pioneer FMCG LLP (383 t)
inspection_checklist: Trace the material flow between the plants in the loop (weighbridge slips, vehicle GPS); the same tonnes may be invoiced round a ring.
Verify the electricity bills directly with the DISCOM (units, tariff, amount); the uploaded copies do not reconcile.
Check installed machinery and shift records against the declared capacity; request production registers for the flagged months.
Ask for the plant's cost sheet; certificates priced below the cost of recycling imply the processing cost was never incurred.
Cross-check the certificate generation dates and category mix against the plant's process route and stock registers.
